summary: The software f16-to-f32 conversion reused the normal-number mantissa shift for subnormals, producing incorrect values. The fix normalizes the subnormal mantissa using the exponent adjustment and masks out the implicit leading bit. The commit adds detecting assertions to test::test_f16_to_f32. Run with use-intrinsics disabled to exercise this implementation. At this historical revision the implementation is in src/lib.rs, not the imported candidate's src/binary16/arch.rs. No tests were run.
